parameters: Turnips from the terraces, apples from the Mill Road.
Welcome to the Haven Inn. Stew's on the fire,
and there are beds upstairs if the pass has worn you out.
The bell rings at dawn and at dusk.
Sit as long as you like. It is quiet in here.
Market day is every day, if you ask Odda.
If it's bent, I can straighten it. If it's broken, I can make it again.
You can hear the falls from my garden when the wind is right.
The spring on the plateau feeds the west lake. Worth the climb.
The spring on the plateau feeds the west lake. Worth the climb.
The square and the drills are yours whenever you want them.
Raiders are coming down both roads, and the square
is all that stands between them and the village.
Will you hold it with us?
Raiders in the square! I will cover you from the roof.
Hold for five turns: the chapel bell will bring the militia.
The square is ours. North Haven owes you.
Fall back! They hold the square for now.
Rest, come back up the road, and we try again.
Three raiders by the fountain, in real time.
Hold the button to fire, aim with the other, dodge and guard.
They got the better of you. Catch your breath.
Three raiders by the fountain, through your own eyes.
Hold the button to fire, aim down the sights.
They got the better of you. Catch your breath.
Twenty of ours, twenty of theirs, and you.
The militia fights by itself: lead from the front. Hold Shift to hurry the turns.
The field is ours. Well led.
The line broke. We will form up again.
Then keep your eyes on the roads.
More of them, down the chapel road!
Enough. I will take this square myself.
That is their captain. Bring him down and the rest will run!
He is down. I never wanted this: I am with you!
